description: This file manages current conversation bindings, including loading, persisting, binding, unbinding, and querying conversation session bindings with support for expiration and normalization.

methods.name: normalizeConversationRef
methods.description: Normalizes a ConversationRef object by trimming and lowercasing relevant fields.

methods.name: buildConversationKey
methods.description: Constructs a unique key string for a conversation based on its normalized reference.

methods.name: buildBindingId
methods.description: Creates a binding ID string for a conversation reference.

methods.name: resolveBindingsFilePath
methods.description: Determines the file path for storing current conversation bindings JSON.

methods.name: isBindingExpired
methods.description: Checks if a session binding record has expired based on its expiresAt timestamp.

methods.name: toPersistedFile
methods.description: Prepares the current bindings map for persistence by filtering expired entries and sorting.

methods.name: loadBindingsIntoMemory
methods.description: Loads bindings from disk into memory, normalizing and filtering expired entries.

methods.name: persistBindingsToDisk
methods.description: Persists current in-memory bindings to disk atomically.

methods.name: enqueuePersist
methods.description: Queues a persistence operation for current bindings.

methods.name: pruneExpiredBinding
methods.description: Removes an expired binding from memory and persists the change.

methods.name: resolveChannelSupportsCurrentConversationBinding
methods.description: Checks if a channel supports current conversation binding based on plugin registry.
